listings.title: 11 & 13 Kingston WAY
listings.description: OVER 6 ACRES OF MOUNTAIN TOP PARADISE LESS THAN 40 MINUTES FROM COEUR D'ALENE. These parcels boast terrific North Idaho views, power and natural gas are close and lots of building options.

listings.title: NKA May Court
listings.description: Back on Market thru no fault of owner. This beautiful .80 Lot in Cataldo is zoned for R-2 Multi-family. Close to Coeur D 'Alene with easy access to I90. Possibilities are endless. Water and Sewer hook-up fees are paid. OWN AND LIVE IN AMERICA'S PREMIER OUTDOOR DESTINATION AREA. Seller is related to agent.

listings.title: 604 W Cameron Ave
listings.description: Very well maintained 4 bedroom, 1 1/2 bath home in a wonderful neighborhood. Views of Silver Mountain from your front yard and quiet solitude while enjoying your back yard. Just minutes from Silver Mountain Resort. Turn the unfinished basement into whatever your needs require. The large open kitchen has plenty of room for a family sized dining table set, a dining hutch, along with a kitchen island with 4 chairs. Main floor laundry is a bonus!

listings.title: 50 S Breeden Ave
listings.description: Nicely remodeled manufactured home. Easy access to I-90, Close to all conveniences. White shed in back yard is not included..Lot is leased, rent is $400 month. includes water, sewer, garbage and snow removal. Buyer must get approved by Silver Star Park management (208) 784-1178

listings.title: 483 Paradise Lane
listings.description: THIS ISN'T JUST A PLACE TO LIVE! Tired of ordinary? This one-of-a-kind artist-designed home breaks all the rules - in the best way. With creative spaces, distinctive design & endless character, it's perfect for someone who wants a home that's as original as they are. This isn't just a place to live-it's a place to be inspired. Perfect for artists, entrepreneurs, remote professionals, or anyone searching for a home as unique as they are, this property is a rare opportunity to own something truly unforgettable. If you've been waiting for a home with personality, vision, and soul, this is it. Home is already wired for an elevator! Beyond the main residence this property features a unique additional dwelling unit. Whether you are looking for a rental income, a private guest retreat, an inspiring artist studio, or a peaceful home office, this versatile space is ready to fit your vision. Every corner celebrates individuality, making it the perfect place. Motivated Seller!! for those who apprciate homes with purpose, and limitless potential. OPPORTUNITIES LIKE THIS DO NOT COME ALONG OFTEN. IF YOU HAVE BEEN WAITING FOR A HOME THAT DARES TO BE DIFFIERENT AND INSPIRES YOU EVERY DAY, THIS IS THE ONE. COME AND SEE IT FOR YOURSELF, YOU WON'T FIND ANOTHER QUITE LIKE IT. COME SEE IT YOURSELF.

listings.title: 301 S Division St
listings.description: Here's your opportunity to acquire your own business building with land included. Beautifully redone office which includes spacious lobby/reception area, 4 private offices, a bathroom and storage area. Alley access for private parking for multiple vehicles is behind the building. Great location on a corner lot across from the Post Office for great exposure to your business.

listings.title: 409 Emerald Dr
listings.description: EXCEPTIONAL 4 BEDROOM LARGE FAMILY HOME IN A BEAUTIFUL NEIGHBORGOOD STEPS AWAY FROM SILVER MOUNTAIN. Pride of ownership is noticed from the minute you pull into the driveway with decades of maintenance and care. Over 2,100 square feet of livable space, a fully finished basement, large windows throughout, terrific sliding glass doors leading out to the scenic back yard with a large cedar deck to take in the stunning view and ample off street parking including a two car attached garage and a paved driveway.

listings.title: 6113 Prichard Creek ST
listings.description: QUIET, PEACEFUL, SERENE & AWAY FROM IT ALL just begins to describe this 3 bedroom 1 bathroom home in Historic Murray, Idaho. The drive along the pristine Coeur d'Alene River brings a sense of calm in itself. The RV, the off road vehicles, there's plenty of space for them all in the 1,152 sqft insulated shop.

listings.title: 119 Pine St
listings.description: THE MOST CHARMING STORYBOOK COTTAGE NESTLED AMONG THE HISTORIC TREE LINED STREETS OF ICONIC WALLACE, IDAHO. From the moment you arrive, the home's character stands out with the spacious front deck that creates plenty of room for outdoor seating, morning coffee, entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surrounding. Mature trees provide wonderful shade, while the established garden beds and beautiful greenhouse with dramatic floor to ceiling windows give the property a tucked-away feel. The character continues into the interior of the home with an updated kitchen, a comfortable inviting living room with hints of natural wood to complement the original personality.
